purpose: Audit and improve a CLI's surface for AI-agent callers (guessable commands, teaching errors, typo inference, --json/capabilities, exit-code contract), then apply fixes and add regression tests.
mechanism: Prose-only skill, no scripts or agents. SKILL.md (156 lines): One Rule + kernel axioms (L8-51), error-rewrite template and grading ladder (L53-88), four operator stacks (L90-96), four mega-command shapes (L98-108), 12-item recurring-fix checklist (L110-123), 11 scoring dimensions (L125-140), 8-step loop discover/enumerate/score/prioritize/apply/test/re-score/ambition gate (L142-151), anti-patterns (L153-156). references/ERGONOMICS-SPEC.md holds the operator deck and JSON shapes. It is a CLI-surface audit-and-apply playbook for a target CLI repo. It does not read agent corrections, session history or git history, so it has no capture, mining or routing step. It is not a retro or correction mechanism.

(a) Provenance gap: skills-local/cli-agent-ergonomics has NO UPSTREAM.md (directory holds only SKILL.md and references/ERGONOMICS-SPEC.md). 30 of 64 skills-local dirs have one; this is one of the 34 without. The distillation provenance exists only as a one-line comment in retired-skills.txt:28 and git history (last touches a27d4aa8, 0e32b0eb, 907402fb, all local skill-tune and trim commits). vendored-drift-check.sh (scripts/vendored-drift-check.sh) discovers files by `find ... -name UPSTREAM.md` (last lines), parses a `github.com/<owner>/<repo>` URL and a hex pin after the word "commit", and compares against `gh api repos/.../commits`. Consequences: it cannot see this fork at all (no file means no row, no WARN). Even with an UPSTREAM.md it could not watch this fork, because the source is a proprietary jsm-hosted skill with no GitHub repo and no commit SHA; the closest field is jsm id 8def1827-be6e-4e1f-be53-f0330afde2b3 and hash 318d8967…e2eb (v18), and the script would report 'no-pin' or 'unreachable'. The create-verification-skill UPSTREAM.md convention (Source URL, Commit SHA, Date, License, vetting statement, itemized Local changes, Unverified local changes) is MIT-GitHub shaped and only partly transposable: the pin would have to be a jsm version plus hash, and a drift check would need a jsm-side query that does not exist. Also note the upstream licence is proprietary, which is why the fork is a distillation (own prose) and not a verbatim vendor; a verbatim UPSTREAM.md "Local changes" list would be misleading.
